fr.sorbonne_u.devs_simulation.simulators.interfaces

Interface RTSimulatorI

  • All Superinterfaces:
    SimulationManagementI, SimulatorI, VariableInitialisationI
    All Known Subinterfaces:
    RTAtomicSimulatorI
    All Known Implementing Classes:
    AtomicRTEngine, CoordinationRTEngine

    public interface RTSimulatorI
extends SimulatorI
    The interface RTSimulationI defines the core behaviour of simulation engines that execute models using the physical clock (of the underlying computer) as simulation clock, or a linear transformation of it (to simulate either faster or slower than the real physical time).

    • Method Detail

      • startRTSimulation

        void startRTSimulation(long realTimeOfStart,
                       double simulationStartTime,
                       double simulationDuration)
        at real time realTimeStart, start a real time collaborative simulation with the simulation clock stating at startTime and lasting simulatedTimeDuration.

        Contract

         pre     realTimeStart > System.currentTimeMillis()
 pre     simulationStartTime >= 0.0
 pre     simulationDuration > 0
 pre     isRTSchedulerSet()
 post    true        // no postcondition.
        Specified by:
        startRTSimulation in interface SimulationManagementI
        Parameters:
        realTimeOfStart - time of start for the simulation, in real time, synchronising all simulation engines.
        simulationStartTime - time at which the simulation starts interpreted in the model simulation time.
        simulationDuration - duration of the simulation interpreted in the model simulation time.

      • setSimulationEndSynchroniser

        void setSimulationEndSynchroniser(java.util.concurrent.Semaphore simulationEndSynchroniser)
        set the synchroniser signalling the end of the simulation.

        Contract

         pre     simulationEndSynchroniser == null || !simulationEndSynchroniser.tryAcquire()
 post    true        // no postcondition.
        Parameters:
        simulationEndSynchroniser - a semaphore used to synchronise with the end of the simulation.

      • computeCurrentSimulationTime

        Time computeCurrentSimulationTime(java.lang.String rtAtomicModelURI)
        compute the current simulation time of the designated model.

        Contract

         pre     rtAtomicModelURI != null && !rtAtomicModelURI.isEmpty()
 post    return != null
        Parameters:
        rtAtomicModelURI - URI of a real time model from which the current time is required.
        Returns:
        the current simulation time of the designated model.
